notes: ACCESS: robots.txt checked first (no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow found; only search-URL and two unrelated /c/ paths disallowed for User-agent:*, our /c/ category paths are allowed). Tier (a) direct HTTP via curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome120) worked end-to-end: fetched robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and the Category-fr-EUR.xml sitemap (526 /maison URLs). The storefront itself is an Angular SPA with an empty SSR shell (no data in raw HTML), so tier (b) Playwright headless was tried next to render it and capture the underlying API calls; Playwright rendering was itself unreliable (static JS chunks on www.galerieslafayette.com returned intermittent 403s that crashed the Angular bootstrap in ~70% of attempts, a client-side asset-CDN flakiness, not a data-access block). The product-listing API endpoint captured from Playwright's network log (sapapi.galerieslafayette.com/occ/v2/gl-fr/products/search, an unauthenticated public OCC REST API, no bearer token needed) was then called directly via curl_cffi and succeeded on 84/84 category queries (all HTTP 200) - stepped back down to tier (a) once the endpoint was known, per the access-tier order. Claude-in-Chrome (tier c) was not needed. TREE: sitemap /maison URLs filtered to the branches containing home-textile or storage content per the two rule files (linge-de-maison, literie, decoration-de-la-maison>{rideaux-et-stores, tapis, objets-de-decoration}, jardin>{mobilier-de-jardin>housses-de-protection, decorations-de-jardin>coffres-de-jardin}, rangement and its 4 subgroups). All other /maison branches (art-de-la-table, culinaire, electromenager, luminaires, mobilier, and the rest of decoration-de-la-maison/jardin) are Kitchen&Dining/Appliances/Lighting/Furniture/Decor and out of scope, so excluded entirely. Each candidate leaf URL was queried via the products/search API and its returned breadcrumbs array checked to confirm it resolves to the exact requested node (no silent parent/sibling substitution observed on any of the 84 calls). For the 'Tapis' node, all 5 sitemap sub-URLs returned 0 products while the parent 'Tapis' node itself returned 430; the site's own categories API (subcategories field) confirmed these 5 are still live, currently-empty subcategories (not stale/merged), so they are recorded as a group with qty=0 children rather than collapsing to the parent URL. QTY: pagination.totalResults from the products/search JSON response for each leaf category query (currentPage=0). This is the site's own exact filtered SKU count; not estimated or aggregated. 'Stores' (blinds) sampled directly (10 products) to confirm they are genuinely fabric (linen/cotton Roman blinds 'Store Bateau', polyester roller blinds 'Store enroulable') before including as Textile per rules/textile.md SS5. EXCLUDED and why: trousses-de-toilette (toiletry travel bag, personal-carrying not home textile); derouleurs/derouleurs-papier-toilette (kitchen film/paper dispensers - excluded from Storage as dispensing-function fixtures, except Toilet Roll Holders which was kept as a flagged LOW-confidence Storage row because the site explicitly places it under Bathroom Storage); distributeurs-de-savon (soap dispensers, Kitchen&Dining fixture); poubelles-de-cuisine/poubelles-de-salle-de-bain (trash/waste bins - waste disposal is not organizational storage per storage.md core principle, even though sited under a 'Rangement' parent); sacs-et-cabas-de-cuisine (reusable shopping totes - personal-carrying bag boundary, storage.md SS6); paravents (folding screens/room dividers - decorative furniture, not storage); vide-poches (decorative entryway valet trays - storage.md SS23/26 explicit 'Decorative Tray -> NOT Storage'); all of mobilier, mobilier-de-jardin (except housses-de-protection), art-de-la-table, culinaire, electromenager, luminaires, and the wall-decor/candles/mirrors/clocks/vases/plants portions of decoration-de-la-maison/objets-de-decoration and autres-decorations-murales (Furniture/Kitchen&Dining/Appliances/Lighting/Wall Decor/Decorative Accessories, out of this combined task's scope per rule boundaries). Pillows/Bolsters/Mattress-Toppers/Bed-Canopy/Bed-Base-Covers/Headboard-Covers/Bed-Skirts/Pillow-Protectors/Cushion-Inserts/Bath-Capes are MEDIUM confidence since they are not verbatim-named in textile.md's example lists but are standard fabric-based home-textile bedding/bath items sold under the site's 'Linge de Maison'/'Literie' departments alongside explicitly-listed sibling items.
